report:
Back nodule, excision

Received in formalin is a well-circumscribed firm tan-white nodule labelled back nodule, measuring 4 x 3 x 2 cm. The cut surface is whorled and tan-white. No capsule is identified. Representative sections in 4 blocks.

(1-4) Lesion with capsule, representative sections.

Sections show a dermal and subcutaneous spindle cell tumour composed of uniform spindle cells arranged in a storiform pattern, infiltrating the subcutaneous fat in a honeycomb pattern. The findings are in keeping with dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans. The lesion is centred in the dermis and is completely excised, with the nearest margin clear by 5 mm.

SKIN AND SUBCUTIS, back nodule, excision - DERMATOFIBROSARCOMA PROTUBERANS; completely excised; see comment

Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans is identified. This benign template does not grade or stage the tumour; the QMH soft tissue sarcoma template should be used where a synoptic report is required.
